jobs.full_reason: A new release appends every row of it, changed or not: the price lane is a part lane whose contract names no compare yet (root ADR-0317 moves it to versions).
jobs.full_cost: measured 2026-10-29 from silver.building_register_apartment_price$snapshots (read-only Trino), every commit of the load: the 2026-10-20 release appended 202,058,239 rows, 6.841 GB in six commits (five of 40,000,000 rows and one of 2,058,239); the 2026-10-11 release the same size. The 2026-10-28 figure (2,058,239 rows) was only its last commit.
jobs.full_tracked_by: PR #919 (root ADR-0317 stage 3: the price lane compares into a versions table and appends only the changed keys)
jobs.description: Silver refresh of the 공동주택가격 lane `building-register-apartment-price` (root ADR-0169 ②): pick the newest complete hub.go.kr release in the Bronze ledger and, unless silver.building_register_apartment_price already records it or a newer one (`unchanged`), export, load and read it back (`changed`). Started when a source_sweep run lands new files, and daily as the fallback (root ADR-0171). Two of the duckdb pool's runs go at a time, lanes or other in-process work: each holds one of its slots and a memory_claim on its unit (root ADR-0599, ADR-0605).
jobs.memory_measured: 2026-11-21, building-register-units. Under 16G: three runs, export 6m47s-7m00s CPU and about 10 minutes of wall time, `memory peak` 13.3-13.4G. Under the 8G this cap was for one day: one run, 61 minutes (17:37:58-18:39:25Z), 10m35s CPU, `memory peak` 7.2G - the export child held 6.68G resident and the cgroup sat at MemoryHigh with 18,933 `high` events and no OOM kill: throttled, not killed. journal `memory peak` 2026-10-18..11-08, 84 runs under 16G: highest 15,668M on 2026-10-20 (building-register-unit-areas). The other lanes measured on the DuckDB path the same day: 0.3G-7.1G.
jobs.memory_headroom_why: A measured working point, not 1.5 x a peak: the export sizes its workers to three quarters of what its cgroup has left, so its peak follows the cap, but about 7G of it does not shrink - at 8G nothing was left for it to work in. 16G is the cap under which the largest export is measured to finish in ten minutes. One number for all 54 lanes, because they share one unit template: it over-reserves for the small lanes (1-7G), and a request per lane comes with the Dagster resource tags that replace this admission (root ADR-0583 follow-up).
jobs.disk_measured: silver-refresh.sh reports in the unit's journal 2026-10-12..11-26 (read 2026-11-26): staged_bytes at most 5982211581 for a release of 202039035 rows. Computed from it: 3x for the release copy and the stage database beside the staged files (they are not logged), at least 2G. The stage logs `duckdb stage closed: disk_bytes=<n>` as it closes (root ADR-0622); a pull request replaces this bound with the highest logged value, nothing is kept between runs.

open_exception.why: Timed out 2026-10-20T04:10Z at 9,008 s; the rerun took 4,329 s. It still writes whole (scope full).

expected_outcome.basis: building HUB files are released monthly (expected_cadence monthly, 1080 h, in the endpoint catalog) plus one daily fallback; measured 2026-11-11 from each unit's journal, 10-12..11-11 (read-only): changed once, on the 10-20 release.
